name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: The order in the Ivory mug's price is exactly $4 more than Greta.
Edith's price is at least $2 more than the order in the Cobalt mug.
The order in the Rose mug's price is lower than both Edith and the order in the Crimson mug.
The order in the Crimson mug's price is immediately below Edith.
Hugo has a higher price than the order in the Rose mug.
The order in the Rose mug's price is immediately next to Hugo.
